question: Ruhr Coal-field is located in which of the following countries?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Germany**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Ruhr Coal-field** is a world-renowned industrial and mining region located in the **western part** of **Germany**.
 
• It is situated within the federal state of **North Rhine-Westphalia**, which is the most populous and industrially significant state in the country.
 
• The region takes its name from the **Ruhr River**, a tributary of the **Rhine River**, which flows through the heart of the coal-producing belt.
 
• This area has historically been the industrial heartland of **Europe**, driven by its vast and high-quality deposits of **bituminous coal** (hard coal).
 
• The concentration of coal mining led to the rapid development of major industrial cities such as **Essen**, **Dortmund**, **Duisburg**, **Bochum**, and **Gelsenkirchen**.
